title: Gradual Typing Bibliography
summary:
The provided link leads to an HTML document that catalogs a bibliography of works related to gradual typing in programming languages. Gradual typing is a programming language feature that allows both statically and dynamically typed variables within a single language. It has a significant role in software development as it provides flexibility and ensures type safety, aiding in the transition between static and dynamic typing.

This bibliography lists various papers and works, providing a comprehensive resource for researchers interested in the field of gradual typing. However, the document itself is not a research paper and does not contain an abstract, defined authors, or a specific publication date.
